[[ $EUID == 2000 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r v </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
IFS= read -r u </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
[[ $v == QEMU && $u =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125

cases.comparison: The exact resident-size assertion is recorded before subsequent operations and is never weakened. The process continues to record allocation, future lock growth and unlock even when resident-size fails; reached failures take precedence over later incomplete observations. Native and candidate effective soft/hard limits are independently recorded. Review each step separately, preserving prior static failure.

files.mlock-future-unlock.sh:
[[ $(type -t mlock) == builtin ]] || exit 125
printf '%s\n' "$$" > "$HOME/candidate-pid"
while IFS= read -r line; do printf '%s\n' "$line"; done < "/proc/$$/limits" > "$HOME/candidate-limits" || exit 125
printf 'ready\n' > "$HOME/candidate-preflight-ready"
IFS= read -r token || exit 125
[[ $token == go ]] || exit 125
snapshot() {
  local line key val unit lck= rss= size=
  while read -r key val unit; do
    case $key in VmLck:) lck=$val;; VmRSS:) rss=$val;; VmSize:) size=$val;; esac
  done <"/proc/$$/status"
  [[ $lck =~ ^[0-9]+$ && $rss =~ ^[0-9]+$ && $size =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || return 1
  printf '%s %s %s\n' "$lck" "$rss" "$size" >"$HOME/$1"
}
snapshot before || exit 125
read -r before_lck before_rss before_size <"$HOME/before"
# Leave room for allocation and shell overhead. Failure here invalidates setup.
(( before_size < 32768 )) || exit 125
mlock all >"$HOME/all.out" 2>"$HOME/all.err"; rc=$?
printf '%s\n' "$rc" >"$HOME/all.status"
(( rc == 0 )) || exit 11
snapshot locked || exit 125
read -r locked_lck locked_rss locked_size <"$HOME/locked"
positive=0; resident=0; future_known=0; growth=0; unlocked_known=0; unlocked_zero=0
(( locked_lck > 0 )) && positive=1
(( locked_lck >= locked_rss )) && resident=1
printf 'locked_lck_kb=%s\nlocked_rss_kb=%s\nlocked_positive=%s\nresident_requirement=%s\n' "$locked_lck" "$locked_rss" "$positive" "$resident" >> "$HOME/mlock-assertions" || exit 125
# Continue after a reached r1 mismatch so later obligations have their own records.
printf -v allocation '%*s' 2097152 ''; allocation_rc=$?
printf 'allocation_status=%s\n' "$allocation_rc" >> "$HOME/mlock-assertions" || exit 125
if (( allocation_rc == 0 )); then
  if snapshot future; then
    read -r future_lck future_rss future_size < "$HOME/future"
    future_known=1; (( future_lck > locked_lck )) && growth=1
    printf 'future_lck_kb=%s\nfuture_rss_kb=%s\nfuture_size_kb=%s\n' "$future_lck" "$future_rss" "$future_size" >> "$HOME/mlock-assertions" || exit 125
  fi
fi
printf 'future_snapshot_recorded=%s\nfuture_growth=%s\n' "$future_known" "$growth" >> "$HOME/mlock-assertions" || exit 125
mlock unlock > "$HOME/unlock.out" 2> "$HOME/unlock.err"; unlock_rc=$?
printf '%s\n' "$unlock_rc" > "$HOME/unlock.status"
printf 'unlock_status=%s\n' "$unlock_rc" >> "$HOME/mlock-assertions" || exit 125
if snapshot unlocked; then
  read -r unlocked_lck unlocked_rss unlocked_size < "$HOME/unlocked"
  unlocked_known=1; (( unlocked_lck == 0 )) && unlocked_zero=1
  printf 'unlocked_lck_kb=%s\n' "$unlocked_lck" >> "$HOME/mlock-assertions" || exit 125
fi
printf 'unlocked_snapshot_recorded=%s\nunlocked_zero=%s\n' "$unlocked_known" "$unlocked_zero" >> "$HOME/mlock-assertions" || exit 125
# Reached candidate failures take precedence; partial diagnostics remain explicit.
(( positive == 1 && resident == 1 )) || exit 12
(( unlock_rc == 0 )) || exit 14
(( unlocked_known == 1 )) || exit 125
(( unlocked_zero == 1 )) || exit 15
(( allocation_rc == 0 && future_known == 1 )) || exit 125
(( growth == 1 )) || exit 13
exit 0
